target.counting_rule: FY2025 budget plan: 8 NTC, 8 JRTC, 4 JMRC, and 2 exportable Pacific rotations.

completed.counting_rule: No accepted source establishes completed rotations.

scheduled.counting_rule: No accepted source establishes the bookmark schedule.

remaining.counting_rule: A fiscal-year target does not establish remaining capacity on 1 September.

available.counting_rule: No accepted source establishes executable opening capacity.

notes: Planning target only. It is excluded from opening inventory, deployment, maintenance, and conservation.
